resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR gives a 30-foot timber tower (9.1 m), which the record uses. The Forest Lookouts page gives 19 feet 6 inches for the tower and a 15-foot-9-inch cab, and does not explain the gap. Kept 9.1 m as the official listing figure, flagged as uncertain.

notes_for_editor: Core build, registration and design facts are from NHLR. No source after 1961 covers staffing, and nothing found says whether the tower is rentable or open to visitors. The NHLR page does not mention rental. The 1944, 1961 and 1964 items are Vernal Express clippings transcribed on the Forest Lookouts page; originals not checked. NHLR id=892 page returned HTTP 500. Height conflict (30 ft vs 19 ft 6 in) is unresolved. Wikipedia Zenobia Peak article has no lookout content and was not cited. Grokipedia not used.
